recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If an old generated artifact later exposes ResearchSubject.progress or research-subject-progress, fix the authoritative generator/source for that artifact, but no current core source edit is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-31891 is a Published/Persuasive BRR technical correction asking to fix a broken ResearchSubject progress binding link; the Jira comment identified http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/research-subject-progress as the failing URL.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-31891, but commit ce804284a7895c1da61c0fc1ec900fd2648bffbe changed the ResearchSubject progress subjectState binding from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/research-subject-progress to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/research-subject-state. BRR minutes later recorded that FHIR-31891 had already been fixed and required no further action.
additional_context: ResearchSubject is active in source/fhir.ini. Applied R6 issue FHIR-43561 removed ResearchSubject.progress.* and introduced ResearchSubject.subjectState and subjectMilestone, and later terminology cleanup moved the active state binding to THO. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion; Confluence hits supported the fixed/no-action conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source contains no ResearchSubject.progress or research-subject-progress references, and the current build links ResearchSubject.subjectState.code to the THO ResearchSubjectState value set.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that removed ResearchSubject.progress and introduced subjectState/subjectMilestone, so the original link location no longer exists in the current resource.
